en.title: Create compact Slack GIFs
en.description: Generate small animated GIFs using the included Python drawing and optimization utilities.
tasks: Generate small animated GIFs using the included Python drawing and optimization utilities.
prerequisites: Python, Pillow, and the packages listed in the included requirements file.
en.example: Use slack-gif-creator. Create a two-second looping loading animation for a Slack emoji and report its size.
en.expectedResult: A GIF with checked dimensions, frame rate, loop, and file size.
limitations: Slack upload limits may change; uploading the GIF is a separate action.

zh.title: 制作 Slack 动图
zh.description: 使用包内 Python 绘制和优化工具生成小体积 GIF。
tasks: 使用包内 Python 绘制和优化工具生成小体积 GIF。
prerequisites: Python、Pillow 及包内 requirements 文件列出的依赖。
zh.example: 请使用 slack-gif-creator：制作一个循环两秒的 Slack 加载动画，并报告文件大小。
zh.expectedResult: 已检查尺寸、帧率、循环和体积的 GIF。
limitations: Slack 上传限制可能变化；上传动图是单独操作。
